_comment: Homepage transfer news banner — hand-edited, never touched by scripts/update_data.py. Set "enabled" to false to hide the banner without deleting this file. "heading" is the small label shown before the list. Each transfer needs "player" (must match a name in player_profiles.json exactly) and "to" (the destination team name, exactly as used elsewhere — see src/data/team-colors.json for the team names on record). The player's *previous* team is looked up automatically from player_profiles.json, not set here.
